# Unnamed flags and vars

> AI-generated, local to this fork. Do not upstream.

- **Flags:** 1133 `FLAG_UNK_*`: **844 never referenced**, 19 referenced but never read (write-only), 270 in use.
- **Vars:** 249 `VAR_UNK_*`: **76 never referenced**, 6 referenced but never read (write-only), 167 in use.
- Not counted: `FLAG_UNK_092`, `FLAG_UNK_09A`, `FLAG_UNK_217`, `FLAG_UNK_ABB`, `VAR_UNK_40CB`, `VAR_UNK_4101`, old names kept as aliases of named constants.

## How this was checked

A flag or var is **used** if any name with its value appears in a script
(`data/maps/*/scripts.pory`, `files/fielddata/script/scr_seq/*.s`), a `map.json`,
C or assembly. Names are not the only way in, so these were also checked:

- C that adds an offset to a base (`FLAG_UNK_97B + n`, `VAR_UNK_4036 + key`, ...);
  the values it can reach count as used (listed in `INDIRECT` in the tool).
- Following-Pokémon interaction rules (`files/a/2/2/0`), which store flag numbers.
- Script commands that take a flag number from a var (`SetFlagVar`,
  `ClearFlagVar`, `CheckFlagVar`): the three std scripts that use them loop over
  named ranges (Bug Contest contestants, Trainer House, item balls).
- Ranges the engine handles as a block: map-temporary flags `0x00`-`0x3F` and
  temp vars are cleared on every warp, daily flags `0xAA0`-`0xB5F` at midnight,
  trainer flags are `0x550` + trainer id, hidden items `0x320` + index.

**Write-only** entries are set or cleared but nothing reads them (or only a
script command no script uses does), so they do nothing. They can be reused
after removing the writes.

Regenerate after renaming or reusing any of these:
`python3 tools/flagusage/flagusage.py --markdown > docs/modding/unknown-flags-vars.md`.
